verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a versioned public API ("Gecko's v1 API") with an OpenAPI spec, so the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or how breaking changes are announced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, sunset/notice windows for API versions, a version-migration guide, independent corroboration of API stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Gecko's v1 API lets you trigger scans, read scan, repository, and vulnerability data, triage findings, manage scan schedules, rotate your GitLab token, and receive webhook events
